name: neuraldeep-design-studio
description: Evidence-led multidisciplinary design from brief to verified output, delivered lean and clean with a Design Receipt on every deliverable: software, images, industrial objects, motion and virtual worlds.

interface.shortDescription: Idea to production, in no time
interface.longDescription: Direct a complete design workflow using composable skills. Explore distinct concepts, establish design DNA, inspect actual outputs and deliver production-aware handoffs, each with a Design Receipt: measured checks, traceability, what was not tested, and AI-use disclosure. Review existing work with design-review. Optional services remain optional.
defaultPrompt: Turn my idea into a verified design and working prototype.
Review this design and give me a Design Receipt.
Develop three distinct product concepts and recommend one.
